title: Slice Spec
description: The contract a caller assembles and passes inline in agent-TDD's (and, for high-risk slices, test-author's) spawn prompt. See INTEROP.md for the full narrative contract this schema mirrors.

taskDescription.description: The behavior to implement, in plain language.

acceptanceCriteria.description: Acceptance criteria / Test Intent: the observable behavior a test must pin down. Required — if this can't be stated yet, do not spawn agent-TDD.

riskTier.description: Governs whether the conditional test-author split applies. Defaults to standard when omitted.

dataContractsAndInterfaces.description: Optional: relevant type signatures, module boundaries, or API shapes the caller already knows. Absence is not an error — agent-TDD explores the codebase itself when it's missing.

preSliceBrief.description: Optional: prior project context the caller already gathered (e.g. from a memory subagent), used to narrow scope before broad exploration.

reviewHandoffMode.description: Optional: defaults to 'pause' (mandatory caller-driven review between Green and Refactor). Set to 'skip' only as a deliberate caller choice, e.g. no reviewer is available this session.
